title: erythrina herbacea var. arborea
intro: Erythrina herbacea var. arborea, commonly known as the Coral Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Erythrina herbacea var. arborea include analgesia, antispasmodic, and diuretic actions, making it useful in treating pain, muscle spasms, and urinary disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
